DO-NOTHING ALTERNATIVE
<u>Advantages</u>
No lands converted to public ownership and therefore no relocation of homes or businesses.
Perpetuates existing environment.
Requires no expenditures.
Disadvantages
In conflict with SEWPP Land Use and Transportation Plan, Milwaukee County Jurisdictional Plan, Milwaukee Area Transit Plan, and Air Terminal Master Plan.
In conflict with national doals of providing direct access between two types of interstate carriers.
Conflicts with City of Milwaukee quals of promoting commercial and industrial growth in the area.
Would not increase airport accessibility nor meet projected traffic demands.
Will not reduce accident potential on arterial street system.
Postpones maintenance and safety improvements.
Highest potential for air and noise pollution from stop-and-go driving.
